none: PAS NLM-2C8401: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably copy of Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, partly off flan. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this tiny coin. Diameter: 10.9mm, Weight: 0.84gms, die axis: possibly 6
